A 3m hollow timber boat with adult-scale thwarts, oars and real skids is an optional authored fitting, accepted only where measured final gun/rig geometry leaves a supported bay clear of access. Its compact dimensions and location are authored against measured clear geometry, not copied from a stock mesh or claimed as Batavia dimensions.

The optional three-metre carried tender is omitted in this delivered sixteen-gun Barque configuration: the measured final gun/rig stations, existing fittings and working hatches leave no accepted full supported bay. The period ship-boat analogue establishes equipment context, not stock-family dimensions or a claim that this particular deck carried one.

Selected hold, cabin-sole and forecastle end-bearing stations are inset 0.12 m within the full floor boundaries. This gives separate 140 mm beams and 130 mm knees genuine clearance at adjoining soles and keeps end knees outside the forecastle breakwall. The measured assembly correction is authored; the cited museum/survey source supplies period timber-construction context, not these dimensions or stations.
